name: Kyle Brown
bio: Kyle Brown is a Southern California country singer-songwriter who calls himself the SoCal cowboy and sums up his music as CA country, dive bars and a little chaos. His single Like I Do came out in January 2026.
bio_source: Written by TOPA from @kyle.brown.official and officialkylebrownmusic.com.
